action.change: Add mandatory durable-exit receipt barrier and receipt-gap reconstruction rule. Preserve authoritative-O liveness priority, single-writer/fence/CAS, revision24 targeting boundary, inbox preflight, payload-bound hold semantics, and no duplicate refire.

before_after.before: Authoritative O could advance during a physical monitor invocation without a corresponding durable note receipt, so configured behavior and executed behavior could not be reconciled from the receipt namespace.
before_after.after: Every post-bootstrap invocation must bind its exit/no-change/blocker outcome to an immutable receipt; a persistence failure becomes durable_receipt_failed and the next invocation must emit a gap diagnostic before any recovery mutation. Missing receipt never proves stop.

rollback.condition: Rollback only if the receipt barrier blocks otherwise safe recovery/liveness work despite note-write capability, causes O mutation only for observability, or misclassifies a possibly-live prior invocation as stopped.

exact_next_action: Verify next O recovery run resolves config 9 and emits a receipt before controllable exit.
If receipt still absent, persist a gap diagnostic before any O recovery mutation and classify the missing durability cause.
Verify C18 canonical producer outputs/integration without changing downstream config unless a concrete defect appears.
